items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: The only thing I played with Raymond was a few spot jobs, that's about all, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, it told about, you know, how they had an act. But, you know, the prelude just didn't tell much, they had a, what, a Howl column, you know, the picture of the Howl. I don't know if you remember that, and anyway, it told about all that. Let's see, what else we've got. Did you work much with Raymond Burke?
The only thing I played with Raymond was a few spot jobs, that's about all, yeah.
Just sharing there. And what about, who is Sidney Wilson?
